description: This file contains a PHP class named ProductPurchased, which is part of the OpenCart admin model extension report namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve product purchase data and count total purchases, interacting with the database to run SQL queries.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: A model class extending the base engine model, providing methods to get purchased products and total purchased count, with filtering options.

methods.name: getPurchased
methods.description: Retrieves a list of purchased products with details such as name, model, quantity, and total, filtered by various criteria including order status and date range, with support for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalPurchased
methods.description: Returns the total number of unique products purchased, filtered similarly to getPurchased, to support reporting total counts.
